Scam alert

Police are urging the public to protect their cryptocurrency information.

We are aware of scammers impersonating police officers and targeting people by phone and email claiming cryptocurrency assets are at risk and directing victims to fake websites designed to steal funds.

If in doubt: Ask for the officer's name and ID number. Hang up and call 105 to verify and request that officer call you back. Never share your recovery/seed phrase. Never enter it into a website.

111

Emergency

One-One-One (111)

Call triple one (111) when you need an emergency response from Police, Fire or Ambulance.

If you have difficulty hearing or talking on the phone you can register here for the 111 TXT service.

About 111 
Call 111

105

Non-Emergency

Ten Five (105)

Use Ten Five (105) to report things that don’t need urgent Police assistance.

Use 105 
Call 105

*555

Driving Incidents

Star Triple Five (*555)

Call Star Triple Five (*555) to report road incidents which are urgent but not life-threatening.

About *555 
Call *555

Call Crime Stoppers to report a crime anonymously. Crime Stoppers is an independent charity.
